name: FFS_USER
description: Contains all users registered in the system.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the user created in the system.

columns.name: PIN_HASH
columns.description: PIN hash based on random salt. Used for encryption on Mobility.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: User's account status. Allowed Values: ( 'active', 'inactive','deleted' ).

columns.name: LANGUAGE_ID
columns.description: User language. F.K. language.lid.

columns.name: REFRESH_RATE
columns.description: Refresh rate of appointments grid in mins.

columns.name: TIME_FORMAT_ID
columns.description: User's account time format . Allowed Values: ( '12-hour', '24-hour' ).

columns.name: DATE_FORMAT_ID
columns.description: User's account date format . Allowed Values: Allowed Values: ('dd/mm/yy', 'mm/dd/yy','dd.mm.yy','yyyy/mm/dd').

columns.name: LONG_DATE_FORMAT_ID
columns.description: User's account long date format .

columns.name: TIME_ZONE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the time zone created in the system.

columns.name: USER_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Reference to the user type ID -> FFS_UTYPE->TYPE_ID.

columns.name: LOGIN_ATTEMPTS
columns.description: Store number of serial failed logins.

columns.name: LOGIN_BLOCKED_TO
columns.description: User login block time. (When number of serial failed logins exceed company->max_login_attempts).

columns.name: LAST_LOGIN
columns.description: Last Value of the Login Date and Time.

columns.name: MOBILE_RESOURCE_COUNT
columns.description: User's amount of resouces showed in Mobile application without pressing 'More' button.

columns.name: MOBILE_ACTIVITY_COUNT
columns.description: User's amount of activities showed in Mobile application without pressing 'More' button.

columns.name: MOBILE_INVENTORY_COUNT
columns.description: User's amount of inventory showed in Mobile application wothout pressing 'More' button.

columns.name: ACTIONS_LINKS_NUM
columns.description: Number of action displaing on appointment grid.

columns.name: WEEK_START
columns.description: User's week start day ('Monday','Sunday').

columns.name: OPTIONS
columns.description: User's options based on selected resource type.

columns.name: CREATED
columns.description: User's creation time in GMT time zone.

columns.name: UPDATED
columns.description: User's last update time in GMT time zone.

columns.name: SOCIALNET_NEW_MESSAGE
columns.description: Deprecated. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: PENDING_SURVEYS
columns.description: Surveys functionality will be deprecated soon.

columns.name: OVERDUE_SURVEYS
columns.description: Surveys functionality will be deprecated soon.

columns.name: DEFAULT_EXPORT_FORMAT
columns.description: It is a default format of a result file for exporting operations.

columns.name: MAIN_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the 'main' resource for this user/technician.

columns.name: DESIGN_THEME
columns.description: User's selected Mobile application design theme.

columns.name: ALLOW_VIBRATION
columns.description: Allow user's Mobile application to vibrate upon receiving updates.

columns.name: ALLOW_DESKTOP_NOTIFICATIONS
columns.description: Allow user's Mobile application to show desktop notifications upon receiving updates.

columns.name: SOUND_THEME
columns.description: User's sound upon receving new nofications in Mobile application..

columns.name: AVATAR
columns.description: Graphical representation of the user.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Associated resource ID to calculate OrganizationID if user hasn't got main_resource_id.

columns.name: COLOR
columns.description: User's Mobile Application selected color.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
